reason: The README describes a desktop integration plugin for dsh web that launches the local service, opens it in the default browser, and adds Windows tray, shortcut, and console-management features.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh web 提供自动启动服务、打开默认浏览器以及 Windows 系统托盘和桌面快捷方式等桌面集成功能。
summaries.en: Provides desktop integration for dsh web by launching the service, opening the default browser, and adding Windows tray and desktop shortcut features.

capabilities: Starts the dsh web service and selects an available port
Automatically opens the default browser to the local web service
Creates and manages a Windows desktop shortcut
Runs a Windows system-tray helper and PowerShell process
Can hide the service console window
Modifies cordis.patch.yml during installation or repair
